meta.title: Recreate Order: Create Order after clearing all optional fields leaves them empty

plan.title: Recreate order with empty optional fields

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event summary as the buyer.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order window.
Clear all optional fields in the Recreate Order window.
Submit the empty form to verify that no required fields block order creation.
Verify the order was created successfully.
Verify the Recreate Order window closes after successful creation.
